reason: The client's protocol is the one the origin its handshake reached chose; a request redirected afterwards to an origin that speaks only HTTP/1.1 is translated on the origin leg, and the client leg stays HTTP/2 (docs/adr/2026-11-19-marasi-gives-the-client-the-origins-protocol.md)

Header case is lost when a pair is translated between HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2: an HTTP/2 field name is lowercase (docs/adr/2026-11-19-http2-transparency-is-end-to-end-for-messages-and-per-leg-for-frames.md)
